tuition.quote: ※ 기준금액 수업료 : 3,433,000원 ※ 해당학기 수강 학점 수에 따라 등록금을 차등 부과함.
tuition.how_found: Search 'KAIST 학사과정 등록금 3,433,000원 학기 등록금 납부 안내 2026' -> KAIST 교무처 notice '2026학년도 봄학기 (재학/복학생/학사과정 신입생) 등록금 납부안내' PDF on www.kaist.ac.kr (p.5, 붙임1). PDF downloaded and text-extracted locally.
tuition.notes: Korean-language notice dated 2026-01-16 for the 2026 Spring semester; the standard undergraduate tuition (기준금액 수업료) is 3,433,000 KRW per semester. Table (p.5): '□ 학사과정 재학생 납입금 등 책정표(연차이내) (단위 : 천원, / 학기) 구 분 수업료 징수기준(A) 장학금(B) 납부액(A-B) 비고 ‘16-’26 입학생 3,433 3,433 - ▪1년차: 전액 장학금 ▪2년차 이상: 평점 2.7 이상 3,433 1,743 1,690 ▪2년차 이상: 평점 2.7 미만' i.e. students admitted 2016–2026 receive a full tuition scholarship in year 1 and in later years if GPA >= 2.7, otherwise pay 1,690,000 KRW. The same 3,433,000 KRW figure appears in the English 2017 notice (https://www.kaist.ac.kr/en/html/footer/0809.html?mode=D&no=e579aaaa84cc6648c2368dc374827604&file_id=15639, 'Freshmen of Undergraduate Course Tuition etc. [Unit : KRW( Won) / Semester] ... Tuition 3,433,000 ... Admission fee 353,000'). The international-specific Cost of Attendance page (admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-undergraduate/support/coa) was unreadable; its unverified search snippet shows the same 3,433,000 KRW/semester (6,866,000 KRW/year) with the KAIST Scholarship covering full tuition for 4 years. No 2027 figure is published on any readable page.

value.name: KAIST Scholarship for International Students — International Undergraduate Scholarship

scholarship_exists.quote: KAIST Scholarship for International Students International Undergraduate Scholarship • Support Organization: University • Support Criteria: standards determined by the guidelines for international student studies • Support Amount: Living expenses 350,000 KRW/month for Class 1
scholarship_exists.how_found: Search 'KAIST international undergraduate tuition fee per semester scholarship international students' -> io.kaist.ac.kr (KAIST International Office) 'International Student's HANDBOOK' PDF, section 'KAIST Scholarship for International Students' (PDF page 40, printed p.74). PDF downloaded and text-extracted locally.
scholarship_exists.notes: Source is the International Office handbook dated 2019; full entry continues ', 200,000 KRW/month for Class 2, and national health insurance fees • Support Period: 4 years(8 semesters) • Principle of double scholarship prohibition applied'. It does not itself state the tuition waiver. The admissions-office page admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-undergraduate/support/scholarships/kaist (unreadable, 503) is the current authoritative page; its unverified search snippet says the scholarship is granted automatically to admitted international students and covers full tuition for 8 semesters, 350,000 KRW/month living expenses and health insurance, conditional on GPA >= 2.7/4.3 after the freshman year. The handbook also says (p.33): 'Undergraduate KAIST scholarship beneficiaries can receive a 100% reimbursement of NHI payments from KAIST.'

scholarship_international.quote: KAIST Scholarship for International Students International Undergraduate Scholarship • Support Organization: University • Support Criteria: standards determined by the guidelines for international student studies
scholarship_international.how_found: Same handbook section as scholarship_exists (io.kaist.ac.kr, PDF page 40).
scholarship_international.notes: The award is named and listed specifically for international students ('KAIST Scholarship for International Students' / 'International Undergraduate Scholarship'), so it is open to non-Korean applicants; the handbook is from 2019 and the current eligibility sentence on admission.kaist.ac.kr could not be read (503).
